# Shortcuts

Header: `winui/ui/containers/Shortcuts.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/containers/Shortcuts.hpp`.

## `ui::Shortcuts`

Keyboard shortcuts for one area of a window. Builds a [ui::ContentHost](../controls/content-host.md#uicontenthost) around [`.content`](#uishortcuts-content).

Each shortcut fires while keyboard focus is anywhere inside [`.content`](#uishortcuts-content), and only then. The focused control gets the key first, then the shortcuts of the innermost area, then those of the areas around it. For a shortcut that fires wherever focus is, give a [ui::Command](../tree/command.md) its `.shortcut` and register it with [Window::add_command()](../tree/window.md#add_command), or offer it through a button or menu item.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<std::string> message;
window.set_content(ui::Shortcuts{
    .items =
        {
            ui::Shortcut{.keys = ui::Ctrl + ui::Key::Enter, .on_pressed = [&] { std::print("{}", message.get()); }},
            ui::Shortcut{.keys = ui::Key::Escape, .on_pressed = [&] { message = ""; }},
        },
    .content = ui::TextBox{.header = "Message", .text = message, .accepts_return = true},
});
```

Every field, in the order a designated initializer names them:

```cpp
ui::Shortcuts{
    .items, .style, .margin, .width, .height, .min_width, .min_height, .max_width, .max_height,
    .horizontal_alignment, .vertical_alignment, .visible, .tool_tip, .accessibility,
    .on_pointer_entered, .on_pointer_exited, .on_got_focus, .on_lost_focus, .on_key_down,
    .on_wheel, .control, .content
}
```

Fields, in declaration order (designators must follow it):

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <span id="uishortcuts-items"></span>`items` | `ui::ShortcutList` |  | The shortcuts. One that returns [ui::NotHandled](../core/namespace-ui.md#nothandled) lets the key go on to the shortcuts further out. |
| <span id="uishortcuts-on_pointer_entered"></span>`on_pointer_entered` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer moved onto the control. |
| <span id="uishortcuts-on_pointer_exited"></span>`on_pointer_exited` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer left the control. |
| <span id="uishortcuts-on_got_focus"></span>`on_got_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus arrived on the control, or on anything inside it, from outside it. A control with nothing focusable in it never gets focus, and never raises this. |
| <span id="uishortcuts-on_lost_focus"></span>`on_lost_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus left the control and everything inside it. |
| <span id="uishortcuts-on_key_down"></span>`on_key_down` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(const ui::KeyEvent&)>` |  | A key pressed while focus is on the control or inside it, before the control's own handling; [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled) stops it there ([Element::on_key_down()](../tree/element.md#on_key_down)). |
| <span id="uishortcuts-on_wheel"></span>`on_wheel` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(const ui::PointerEvent&)>` |  | A wheel turn over the control, before the control scrolls; [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled) stops it there ([Element::on_wheel()](../tree/element.md#on_wheel)). |
| <span id="uishortcuts-control"></span>`control` | `ui::ControlOut<ui::Shortcuts>` |  | Out: the handle that receives the built control. |
| <span id="uishortcuts-content"></span>`content` | `ui::Spec` |  | The area the shortcuts belong to. |

Plus the common fields `style`, `margin`, `width`, `height`, `min_width`, `min_height`, `max_width`, `max_height`, `horizontal_alignment`, `vertical_alignment`, `visible`, `tool_tip`, `accessibility` every spec carries ([conventions](../conventions.md#common-fields-on-every-spec)).

### build

```cpp
std::unique_ptr<Element> build()&&
```

Consumes the spec and returns the built [ui::ContentHost](../controls/content-host.md#uicontenthost); the caller owns it.

## struct Shortcut

A key combination that invokes an action while focus is inside the element that holds it ([Element::add_shortcut()](../tree/element.md#add_shortcut)). Unless [`on_pressed`](#struct-shortcut) returns [ui::NotHandled](../core/namespace-ui.md#nothandled) the key goes no further; a NotHandled one goes on to an ancestor's shortcuts and then to the focused element.

Example: 
```cpp
auto* editor = window.set_content(
    std::make_unique<ui::StackControl>(ui::Orientation::Vertical));
editor->add_shortcut({.keys = ui::Ctrl + ui::Key::S, .on_pressed = [] { save_document(); }});
// Ctrl+S now saves whenever focus is anywhere inside `editor`.
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `keys` | `KeyCombo` |  | The key and exactly the modifiers that fire it; an empty key combination never matches. |
| `on_pressed` | `Callback<Handling()>` |  | The action. Returning nothing, or [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled), stops the key; [ui::NotHandled](../core/namespace-ui.md#nothandled) lets it go on. |

## class ShortcutList

The shortcuts of a [ui::Shortcuts](#uishortcuts), written as a braced list of [ui::Shortcut](#struct-shortcut). A shortcut owns its handler, which may capture move-only state, so the list takes them by value.

### entries

```cpp
std::vector<Shortcut> entries
```

The shortcuts, in order.

### ShortcutList

```cpp
ShortcutList() = default
```

No shortcuts.

### ShortcutList

```cpp
template <typename... S>
ShortcutList(S&& ... items)
    requires (sizeof...(S) > 0 && (std::same_as<S, Shortcut> && ...))
```

The shortcuts in order. Implicit, so [`.items = {ui::Shortcut{...}, ...}`](#struct-shortcut) works.

### ShortcutList

```cpp
ShortcutList(const ShortcutList&) = delete
```

Move-only, since a shortcut owns its handler.

### operator=

```cpp
ShortcutList& operator=(const ShortcutList&) = delete
```

### ShortcutList

```cpp
ShortcutList(ShortcutList&&) = default
```

### operator=

```cpp
ShortcutList& operator=(ShortcutList&&) = default
```

### add

```cpp
void add(Shortcut shortcut)
```

Appends one shortcut, for a list put together in a loop.
